# BeFirst — Free SEO Audit Tool

## What is BeFirst?
BeFirst is a free SEO audit tool that grades any web page from A+ to F. It checks meta tags, page speed, keywords, broken links, mobile-friendliness, and schema markup using Google's public Search Essentials.

## Who is it for?
- Website owners who want to know why their site isn't ranking
- Small businesses and freelancers who can't afford expensive SEO tools
- bloggers, e-commerce stores, portfolio sites — any public webpage

## Key Features
- Single-page SEO audit with letter grade (A+ to F)
- Meta tag analysis (title, description, Open Graph)
- Page speed scoring
- Keyword gap detection
- Broken link detection
- Mobile-friendliness check
- Schema markup validation
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) audit
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) audit

## Pricing
- Free: single-page audit with email signup
- Starter (Rs 99): multi-page crawl, competitor compare
- Pro (Rs 799): full-site audit, priority support, API access
